scope.goal: Remove unconditional capture-registry roots without invalidating external Context/DomainRun owners or unresolved native work.
implementation: Opaque exact-type handles strongly own a private weakref-capable dict state.
Global id-to-state registries use WeakValueDictionary; neither registry strongly roots callback-to-handle cycles.
State retains the original-handle identity witness; lookup requires registry state, handle state and original handle to match.
All public APIs are unchanged. Fake/copied handles and selected registration replacement remain fail-closed.
No public release API, no GC authority, no dropping unknown/HOLD owners, no alteration of other agents' native/loop code.
limits: Collection requires all external consumers to release their references and a GC pass for cycles. It is not an immediate-memory-release or global-cap guarantee.
Trusted registration factories or callers can intentionally retain a handle; that is not removed.
In-process private registry mutation remains trusted-Python scope, not an OS security sandbox.
PreparedSources payload test measures actual six bytes from two real CPU publications, not RSS or a maximum-size memory benchmark.
Interface lifetime changes alone do not retire native owners or unregister controller-loop exit/signal hooks.

original_nine.controls: External run and BoundPolicy remain usable; fake/copied context/run and domain/policy registration replacement are refused.
failure_meaning: Unused InterfaceContext survives gc.collect solely through the baseline capture registry.
The same survives a trusted Domain/Policy callback back-reference cycle.
Unused DomainRun/context/PreparedSources owner survives after two genuine CPU artifact publications (six bytes), including a Domain callback back-reference.
original_nine.classification: Confirmed baseline retention behavior, one lifetime root cause; not missing API or constructor error.

added_four.classification: New mechanism requirements for exact handle-owned state witness; not run against a baseline without that private field.
added_four.cases: Context and run, each private state removed or replaced by a plain copied dictionary.
